items.title: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
items.title_zh: 随着 CoreWeave 债券收益率突破 16%，AI 的“信用卡”正变得越来越贵
items.summary: Coreweave's steep yields reflect stress in the AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown
items.summary_zh: CoreWeave 高企的收益率反映出 AI 债券市场的压力，投资者担心数据中心建设放缓。

items.title: Dynasties or Parity? How MLB, the NFL, and the NBA try to find competitive balance
items.title_zh: 王朝还是均势？MLB、NFL 与 NBA 如何寻求竞争平衡
items.summary: MLB executive tells CNBC dynasties can be 'wonderful' for a league if spending rules are fair for all teams.
items.summary_zh: MLB 高管对 CNBC 表示，只要支出规则对所有球队公平，王朝对联盟也可以是“好事”。

items.title: This pharmaceutical ETF is outperforming. Why it could keep climbing
items.title_zh: 这只制药 ETF 表现领先，为何还可能继续上行
items.summary: The Invesco Pharmaceuticals ETF continues to outperform as other areas of the market weaken, making it an investment opportunity worth watching.
items.summary_zh: 在市场中其他领域走弱之际，Invesco 制药 ETF 持续跑赢，成为一个值得关注的投资机会。

items.title: Montana votes to ban corporate political money. Next stop? Probably the Supreme Court
items.title_zh: 蒙大拿州公投禁止企业政治献金，下一站或为最高法院
items.summary: Montana voters approved a novel strategy to restrict corporate political spending, setting up a constitutional fight that could reach the Supreme Court.
items.summary_zh: 蒙大拿选民通过了一项限制企业政治支出的新策略，由此引发的宪法之争可能诉至最高法院。

items.title: Data center double-down: Hassett says blue wave won't stop AI build-out
items.title_zh: 数据中心再加码：哈塞特称民主党浪潮不会阻止 AI 基建
items.summary: Data centers are a crucial part of President Donald Trump's push to win the global artificial intelligence race, which he continues despite the midterm results.
items.summary_zh: 数据中心是特朗普总统争夺全球人工智能竞赛胜利的关键一环，尽管中期选举结果不利，他仍将继续推进。

items.title: Wall Street's fear gauge may be flashing a buy sign
items.title_zh: 华尔街恐慌指标可能正在发出买入信号
items.summary: History shows that similar spikes in the VIX have been good entry points for stocks
items.summary_zh: 历史显示，VIX 出现类似飙升时往往是股票的良好入场点。

items.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
items.title_zh: 美国 10 月新增非农就业 16.5 万人，远超预期；失业率降至 4.1%
items.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate was expected to hold steady at 4.2%.
items.summary_zh: 市场原本预期 10 月非农增加 5.9 万人，失业率维持在 4.2%。

items.title: Anthropic IPO announcement odds drop on Kalshi following midterms and AI sell-off
items.title_zh: 中期选举与 AI 抛售之后，Kalshi 上 Anthropic 宣布 IPO 的概率下降
items.summary: Kalshi traders cut the odds of an Anthropic IPO announcement before December as AI stocks sold off after Democrats won control of Congress.
items.summary_zh: 民主党赢得国会控制权后 AI 股遭到抛售，Kalshi 交易员下调了 Anthropic 在 12 月前宣布 IPO 的概率。

items.title_zh: 韩股暴跌近9%触发熔断，日经跌破6万点
items.title: Korean stocks plunge nearly 9 percent, triggering a circuit breaker; Nikkei falls below 60,000
items.summary_zh: 韩国首尔综指跌幅扩大至8.8%，跌破5000点关口，触发熔断
items.summary: The KOSPI extended its decline to 8.8 percent, breaking below the 5,000 level and triggering a circuit breaker.
